_comment: Golden fixture for LoadDiscoveredServers / load_discovered_servers — input ~/.shed/config.yaml text -> expected []ServerTarget. Read by BOTH the Go runner (cmd/shed-host-agent/golden_test.go) and the Rust runner (in crates/shed-host-agent/src/controltoken.rs tests) so the two impls cannot drift together. Pins the load-bearing divergences from shed-core::ShedConfig: ssh_port defaults to 0 (NOT 22) when omitted, and empty-host entries are skipped. Targets are sorted by name. auth_mode is carried VERBATIM from the entry and is NOT defaulted: "" (never recorded, legacy entry) and "token" (recorded) stay distinguishable, because only the former means "this client has never been told".

vectors.name: ssh_port default 0, empty-host skipped, api_url vs http fallback, auth_mode carried, sorted
vectors.config_yaml:
servers:
  https-with-ssh:
    api_url: https://a.example:8443
    host: a.example
    ssh_port: 2222
    auth_mode: mtls
  https-no-ssh:
    api_url: https://b.example:8443
    host: b.example
    auth_mode: token
  plain:
    host: c.example
    http_port: 9000
  empty-host:
    ssh_port: 2222

vectors.name: credentials_token + raw tls_cert_fingerprint carried; ssh_port parsed; default http_port 8080
vectors.config_yaml:
servers:
  s:
    host: s.example
    ssh_port: 8022
    credentials_token: tok-abc
    tls_cert_fingerprint: sha256:AABBcc

vectors.name: auth_mode is verbatim: an unrecognized value is neither normalized nor rejected
vectors.config_yaml:
servers:
  weird:
    api_url: https://w.example:8443
    host: w.example
    ssh_port: 2222
    auth_mode: MTLS
